methodology.xref: AArch64 ADRP/ADD reference passed as x1 to the console-variable reference constructor at 0x32635cc
methodology.default_decode: x2 points either into ELF .data (VMA 0xb9e1c40-0xba34ae0), whose four file-backed bytes are decoded as little-endian uint32, or into zero-initialized .bss (VMA 0xba34b00-0xbdef188)
methodology.help_decode: UTF-16LE string addressed by x3 in the same registration sequence
methodology.scope: compiled referenced defaults only; startup transition logs are required before treating a value as the effective Android default

observations.help: Enables maps of dynamic vertex buffers to go to a staging buffer
If true, use glMapBuffer otherwise use glBufferSubdata.
Maximum amount of data to send to glBufferSubData in one call
If true, rebind GL_TEXTURE_BUFFER's to their GL_TEXTURE name whenever the buffer is modified.
If true, use dynamic buffer orphaning hint.
If true, use GL_MAP_UNSYNCHRONIZED_BIT when mapping write only buffers.
If true, it will use persistent mapping for the Staging Buffer.
Size of the UBO pool, 0 disables UBO Pool
Enables direct writes to the UBO via Buffer Storage

decision.mapping_and_orphaning_flags: do_not_add_enablement_candidates: map-buffer, discard, unsynchronized mapping, and persistent-mapping capability are already compiled 1 and were confirmed 1 in live storage; staging is separately compiled and live 0
decision.promotion_boundary: No static default or cold boot establishes late-PvP FPS or rendering correctness. Promotion requires matched late-PvP A/B plus visual and crash gates.
